test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years compounded annually?
solution:
**Given:**

P = Rs. 64000

r = 5% per annum = 5/100 = 0.05 (in decimal)

n = 1 (as the interest is compounded annually)

t = 2 years

**Calculation:**

A = 64000(1 + 0.05/1)²

= 64000(1.05)²

= 64000 × 1.1025

= Rs. 70560

So, the total amount after 2 years would be Rs. 70560.

Interest = A - P

= 70560 - 64000

= Rs. 6560

**Therefore, the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years, compounded annually, will be Rs. 6560.**
